review_pass_1.method: Internal scientific and syllabus review of saved HTML, source records, reviews, abstracts and textbook knowledge.
corrections: Separated cellular dominance from inheritance and malignant sufficiency.
Clarified GAP-mediated hydrolysis and receptor-independent output versus universal autonomy; HER2 has no known direct soluble ligand.
Distinguished MYC regulatory relocation from coding fusion, gene copy from activity, and VAF from cell prevalence.
Checked hypothetical numerical examples and diagrams; retained physiological and comparative boundaries.

review_pass_2.method: Internal teaching/exam review of saved chapter; not external peer review.
corrections: Strengthened distractors/explanations in 25 questions, then revised six Part C items to multistep comparative analysis.
Added prerequisite internal links and measurement comparison table; corrected responsive table styling.
Checked 150 teaching paragraphs; zero exact duplicates, maximum pairwise lexical Jaccard 0.307; purposeful conceptual reinforcement, not proof of semantic originality.
Preserved existing reader and dynamic navigation.

scope.evidence: All Academy roadmap microtopics covered, aligned to official oncogene syllabus and archived SET.

accuracy.deduction: Not all primary full texts accessible; reviewed abstract/review evidence and textbook mechanisms.

depth.deduction: Some conceptual reinforcement across mechanism and reasoning sections; not independently learner-tested.

analytical.deduction: Numerical datasets hypothetical rather than original research data; 9 worked examples.

practice.deduction: 54 explained original questions; difficulty not psychometrically calibrated and some analytical questions shorter than advanced Part C.

technical.deduction: Static HTML/JS source checks only; no interactive browser/device test.

limitations: Internal self-review, not external peer review.
